title: Advancement Race Modpack
description: This modpack is made to play my mod, ac-race with optimisation mods and QOL mods as well.
body:
# Advancement Race - Optimized Modpack
![Advancement-Race](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06ba50be0367abc52064499a116e81e068ad6aa1.png)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[![curseforge_button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9d2b051ede5f22e74030c06ccf8c16db2d57b49.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/members/nolini135/projects)

[![modrinth_button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39391520edba2a31229b635416e28760cc6e6079.png)](https://modrinth.com/user/nolini135)

[![pmc_button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25ec8938dc84b233e222565e65c9fa620f2acded.png)](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/nolini135/)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A lightweight, performance‑friendly modpack built to enhance the [Advancement Race mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/ac-race) experience. Designed for smooth gameplay, better visibility, and improved quality of life, this pack keeps the vanilla feel while making progression clearer and more enjoyable.
# Features
![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/825365ba3dae385127972ff838a4674384219dea.png)
- Performance optimizations to keep the game running smoothly on a wide range of systems
- clean, structured, and easy‑to‑navigate advancement tree
- Minimap & World Map for improved navigation without breaking immersion
- Quality‑of‑life improvements that enhance gameplay without altering core mechanics
- Fully compatible with the Advancement Race mod and designed to support competitive or casual advancement‑based play

# About AC‑Race
![About-acrace](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f42d3147be600f8cfdc81d05844822534f839bc5.png)

Advancement Race is a custom mod developed by me, and it’s still in early development.
This means:
- It’s not perfect yet
- Features are evolving quickly
- Feedback is extremely valuable
This modpack exists to provide the best possible environment for AC‑Race while the mod continues to grow and improve.

# Purpose
This modpack exists to provide the ideal environment for the Advancement Race mod. It improves clarity, reduces lag, and gives players the tools they need to track progress efficiently during advancement‑focused challenges. Perfect for:
- Multiplayer advancement races
- Speedrunning‑style progression
- Casual worlds where players want better visibility and smoother performance
- Servers looking for a clean, optimized base pack
